reportHeadline: Town share the points in a dramatic new-home opener against
reportIntro: Bollington Town began life at their new home of Church Lane with a dramatic 1-1 draw against Poynton, twice denied by a resolute visiting side before substitute Jack Heppell's 89th-minute leveller salvaged a point on an afternoon that saw red cards at both ends — Poynton reduced to ten around the hour mark before Jacob Callum Hodgson was sent off for Town deep into stoppage time.

firstHalfEvents.title: Early Free-Kick
firstHalfEvents.description: Poynton were penalised for a handball in midfield inside the opening minute, handing Town an early free-kick to settle into the game.

firstHalfEvents.title: Hanks Goes Close in 1v1
firstHalfEvents.description: **Declan Hanks** found himself clean through one-on-one with the Poynton keeper but couldn't find a way past him — an early sign of Town's attacking intent.

firstHalfEvents.title: Bowers Free-Kick Off Target
firstHalfEvents.description: A handball outside their own box gave Town another free-kick, but **Jake Bowers**' effort from range drifted off target.

firstHalfEvents.title: Bowers Strike from the Edge of the Box
firstHalfEvents.description: Town forced an early corner that was only partially cleared, and **Jake Bowers** met the loose ball with a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort was cleared without seriously testing the keeper.

firstHalfEvents.title: Connolly Wins a Corner
firstHalfEvents.description: **Joshua Connolly** created another opening down the flank, forcing a second corner for Town inside the first quarter of an hour.

firstHalfEvents.title: Bowers Effort Saved
firstHalfEvents.description: The resulting corner was met by **Jake Bowers**, whose shot was well held by the Poynton goalkeeper.

firstHalfEvents.title: Richardson Chance
firstHalfEvents.description: **George Richardson** had Town's next sight of goal, though the opportunity went begging as Poynton held firm.

firstHalfEvents.title: Hanks Crowded Out
firstHalfEvents.description: **Declan Hanks** was inches from breaking the deadlock, blocked out by two Poynton defenders at the last moment.

firstHalfEvents.title: Hibbert Booked in Midfield Coming-Together
firstHalfEvents.description: **Ryan Hibbert** was shown a yellow card after a mistimed tackle sparked an altercation with a Poynton player, with the free-kick still going Town's way despite the caution.

firstHalfEvents.title: Poynton Player Booked for Foul on Hibbert
firstHalfEvents.description: The tables turned five minutes later when a Poynton player was booked for an illegal challenge on **Ryan Hibbert**, Town coming away with a goal-kick from the passage of play.

firstHalfEvents.title: Joyce Denies Poynton
firstHalfEvents.description: Poynton tested **Matthew Joyce** with a long-range effort that the Town keeper did well to save, before the visitors shoved **Jake Bowers** off the ball moments later — no card shown, but another free-kick given to Town.

firstHalfEvents.title: Richardson Chance Gathered by Keeper
firstHalfEvents.description: **George Richardson** was again denied a clear sight of goal, the Poynton keeper gathering at his feet before he could get a shot away.

firstHalfEvents.title: Bowers Free-Kick Wide
firstHalfEvents.description: Excellent tackling and midfield graft from **Jake Eastham** teed up **George Richardson**, who was scythed down by a mistimed challenge just outside the box. **Jake Bowers** stepped up to the resulting free-kick but dragged his effort wide of the target.

secondHalfEvents.title: Poynton Free-Kick
secondHalfEvents.description: Poynton were awarded a free-kick as the second half got underway, though Town's defence stood firm.

secondHalfEvents.title: Town Free-Kick Comes to Nothing
secondHalfEvents.description: Town had a free-kick of their own in a promising area moments later but couldn't make the opportunity count.

secondHalfEvents.title: Poynton Reduced to Ten
secondHalfEvents.description: Poynton had a player sent off around the hour mark, leaving them to play out the remainder of the game a man light.

secondHalfEvents.title: Connolly Receives Treatment
secondHalfEvents.description: Play was halted as **Joshua Connolly** needed treatment for an injury, a stoppage that would ultimately end his afternoon.

secondHalfEvents.title: Double Change for Town
secondHalfEvents.description: **Jake Bowers** and **Joshua Connolly** were both withdrawn, with **Maxwell Berkeley** and **Muhammad Abdullah Butt** introduced to freshen things up.

secondHalfEvents.title: Eastham Booked
secondHalfEvents.description: **Jake Eastham** was shown a yellow card following a mistimed tackle, some hard luck after a fine afternoon of tackling and midfield work.

secondHalfEvents.title: Poynton Take the Lead
secondHalfEvents.description: Poynton broke the deadlock against the run of play to make it 0–1, stunning the home crowd on Town's first outing at Church Lane.

secondHalfEvents.title: Milsom Header Saved
secondHalfEvents.description: **Daniel Williams** won a corner that **Alfie Earith** delivered into the box, and **Philip Milsom** rose highest to head goalwards — only to be denied by a good save from the Poynton keeper.

secondHalfEvents.title: Poynton Free-Kick
secondHalfEvents.description: Poynton had another free-kick in a dangerous area, but Town's backline dealt with the danger.

secondHalfEvents.title: Heppell Introduced
secondHalfEvents.description: **Daniel Williams** made way for **Jack Heppell**, a substitution that would prove decisive.

secondHalfEvents.title: Butt Header Just Wide
secondHalfEvents.description: **Muhammad Abdullah Butt** rose well at the back post but couldn't quite direct his header on target — a close call as Town pushed for an equaliser.

secondHalfEvents.title: Hodgson On for Richardson
secondHalfEvents.description: **George Richardson** made way for **Jacob Callum Hodgson** as Town searched for fresh legs in the hunt for a leveller.

secondHalfEvents.title: Takiar Replaces Earith
secondHalfEvents.description: **Arjun Takiar** was introduced in place of **Alfie Earith** as Town continued to chase a late equaliser.

secondHalfEvents.title: Goal — Jack Heppell
secondHalfEvents.description: Town got their reward. **Declan Hanks** picked out **Jack Heppell** with a well-weighted pass, and the substitute made no mistake to level the scores. 1–1, and Church Lane erupted for Town's first goal at their new home.

secondHalfEvents.title: Hodgson Sent Off
secondHalfEvents.description: A dramatic stoppage time saw a Poynton player go down under a challenge from **Jacob Callum Hodgson**, with the referee brandishing a straight red card for violent conduct. Town saw out the remaining moments a man light to secure a point on their new home ground.

pullQuote: A red card, a stoppage-time leveller, and a new home to remember — Town's first day of the new era had it all.
matchVerdict: Bollington Town's first competitive outing at Church Lane was a fitting curtain-raiser for the new era — combative, eventful, and ultimately deadlocked. Town were the sharper side for long spells of the first half, forcing a string of corners and half-chances through **Jake Bowers**, **Declan Hanks** and **George Richardson**, but couldn't find a breakthrough despite going in level at the break having weathered two bookings of their own around a spirited midfield battle with **Ryan Hibbert** at the heart of it.

Poynton were reduced to ten men around the hour mark, yet still found a way to make the breakthrough on 66' against the run of play — forcing Town to chase the game with the introduction of fresh legs off the bench. Town's persistence paid off in the closing stages when **Declan Hanks** picked out substitute **Jack Heppell**, who finished coolly to level the scores with virtually his final touch of a productive cameo.

The drama wasn't done — **Jacob Callum Hodgson**, on for barely four minutes, was shown a straight red card deep into stoppage time, levelling the numbers back up and leaving Town to see out the closing moments with ten men themselves. A point apiece felt about right on the balance of play, and a memorable way to christen the new ground.
